definition: A system for assigning and resolving persistent identifiers for digital or other identified objects.
entry_text: A system for assigning and resolving persistent identifiers for digital or other identified objects.
example: A repository exposes a persistent handle that continues to resolve after a record moves to a new URL.
label: Handle System

sources.note: RFC 3650 explains persistent handles and resolution independent of location. A moved resource remains reachable when its binding is maintained.
